# Mojdeh Saadati

Canonical website: https://mojdeh-saadati.github.io/

## Identity
Mojdeh Saadati is a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics at Iowa State University.

## Research areas
- Scientific machine learning
- AI for scientific discovery
- Uncertainty quantification
- Out-of-distribution detection
- Reinforcement learning
- Causal inference with missing data
- Differentiable simulation
- Functional data analysis
- AI for agriculture

## Current research framing
Mojdeh develops machine-learning methods for scientific and decision-making systems, especially methods that combine learning with mechanistic simulation, quantify predictive uncertainty, remain robust under distribution shift, and accelerate large-scale scientific exploration.

## Education
- Ph.D., Computer Science and Applied Mathematics, Iowa State University (in progress)
- M.S., Computer Science, Iowa State University, 2020
- B.S., Computer Science, University of Tehran, 2016

## Selected publications
1. From Simulation to Discovery: AI Enabled Probabilistic Emulation of Mechanistic Crop Systems. Under review.
2. Genomic and phenomic prediction for soybean seed yield, protein, and oil. The Plant Genome.
3. Out-of-distribution detection algorithms for robust insect classification. Plant Phenomics.
4. Deep learning powered real-time identification of insects using citizen science data. PNAS.
5. 3D reconstruction of plants using probabilistic voxel carving. Computers and Electronics in Agriculture.
6. Adjustment criterion for recovering causal effects from missing data. ECML-PKDD.
